tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Find Lookbk agent skills for something the user wants to make, such as "product launch video", "pitch deck", "og image" or "3D hero". Returns the best matches with slug, output type, free or Pro, and page URL.

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Read one Lookbk skill in full: what it makes, what it needs, what is in the package, what it is not for, an example prompt, and the command that installs it.

tools.name: list_video_skills
tools.description: List every Lookbk video skill (launch films, kinetic type, data stories, creator overlays, explainers). Each renders an MP4 on the user’s machine.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Get the one-line terminal command that installs a Lookbk skill, optionally for one agent (claude-code, codex, cursor, gemini-cli, github-copilot, opencode, vs-code) and for the user’s home folder or the current project. The server never runs it; the agent runs it in the user’s terminal.
